task.name: pick_marker_transfer_place_cup
task.description: Use the right arm to grasp the marker, transfer it to the left arm and then place it in the cup.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the marker.
2. Grasp the marker with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to a transfer position.
4. Move the left arm to the transfer position to receive the marker.
5. Grasp the marker with the left arm.
6. Release the marker from the right arm.
7. Move the left arm to align with the cup.
8. Release the gripper to place the marker into the cup.
